description: Synthetic golden labels for hit@k. A hit at k means the top k ranked candidate_ids include at least one id in expected_candidate_ids. Order is best-first and is not required for the hit. partial_candidate_ids are near-misses and are not required.

queries.query: Hong Kong hybrid AI engineer who trains models in PyTorch or TensorFlow, writes SQL, and has shipped a production scorer or a retrieval assistant that cites source passages.
Hong Kong data analyst who writes SQL, builds Tableau or Power BI dashboards, reconciles metrics to a business total, and explains the result to non-analysts.
Product manager with at least four years owning discovery, roadmap choices, and post-launch metrics for B2B or payments software, not a program manager coordinating a vendor plan.
Hong Kong HR business partner who coaches managers, runs employee-relations cases, and advises on local employment practice. Recruiting-only profiles are not enough.
Hong Kong IT support or systems administrator for Microsoft 365, endpoint builds, identity joiner-mover-leaver, and first-line network faults, with clear ticket updates.
